description: Run the regulatory affordability gate for one main borrower and up to three joint borrowers. Given each borrower's income, rental, pledged/unpledged assets and liabilities plus a proposed loan, returns the qualifying income (after MAS haircuts), the TDSR and MSR for the proposed loan, the income-weighted average age (IWAA), and the maximum loan under both HDB/EC and private property rules. Use this upstream of `recommend_packages` to confirm what a borrower can qualify for.

ageConvention.description: How borrower age is computed; defaults to birth-date. The tRPC router resolves it per bank from the bank slug.

asOfDate.description: Reference date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD) for age and IWAA; defaults to today.

benchmarkRate.description: MAS medium-term stress rate, as a percentage (e.g. 4.0 = 4%, not 0.04).

borrowers.description: The main borrower followed by any joint borrowers; their qualifying incomes and liabilities are pooled.

age.description: Borrower age in years. When supplied it is used directly and dateOfBirth is ignored.

annualNoa.description: Annual income per the IRAS Notice of Assessment, in SGD. Only used when employedTwoYears is true; recognised variable income is then max(NOA − basic×12, annualVariableIncome).

annualVariableIncome.description: Yearly bonus, commission and allowances, in SGD; 70% of it, spread over 12 months, counts.

dateOfBirth.description: Borrower date of birth, e.g. "1990-05-14"; must not be in the future. Gives the age at `asOfDate` when `age` is not supplied. A borrower with neither is treated as age unknown and left out of the IWAA.

employedTwoYears.description: True if the borrower has ≥2 years with the current employer, which permits using the NOA for variable income.

liabilities.description: Up to three monthly liability lines.

label.description: What the liability is, e.g. "car loan" or "credit card". For display only.

monthlyAmount.description: Monthly repayment for this liability, in SGD.

monthlyBasicIncome.description: Fixed monthly salary before deductions, in SGD; counts in full.

monthlyRentalIncome.description: Monthly rental income (requires a valid tenancy agreement), in SGD. Recognised at 70%.

pledgedFunds.description: Eligible financial assets pledged ≥4 years, in SGD. Amortised over 48 months at 100%.

unpledgedFunds.description: Eligible financial assets not pledged, in SGD. Amortised over 48 months at 30%.

combinationSplit.description: For the pledge/show combination: fraction of the income gap covered by pledged funds; the remainder is covered by show funds. Defaults to 0.5.

existingHousingLoans.description: Number of outstanding housing loans held. Selects the LTV tier (0 -> full, 1 -> second, 2+ -> third). Defaults to 0 when omitted.

loanTenureYears.description: Loan tenure being tested, in years; checked against the longest tenure these borrowers can get.

propertyType.description: Property type: hdb, ec or private. Sets the maximum loan tenure (35y private and EC, 30y HDB) and the lower-LTV-tier triggers. EC also carries MSR, like HDB.

proposedLoanAmount.description: The loan amount being tested, in SGD.

targetLoanAmount.description: Optional target loan amount, in SGD. With targetPurchasePrice it sets the LTV (loan / price, capped at the applicable LTV) and takes precedence over targetLtvCap. Without a price, the price is derived as the loan divided by the applicable LTV. Either way toReachTarget is produced.

targetLtvCap.description: Optional manual LTV cap for the target loan, as a decimal (e.g. 0.6 = 60%). When set and below the applicable LTV, toReachTarget is sized at this lower LTV so the loan and unlock figures reflect a smaller loan the borrower chooses to take.

targetPurchasePrice.description: Optional target purchase price, in SGD. When set, the result includes toReachTarget: the loan needed at the first-loan LTV and the eligible funds to reach it.

name: check_eligibility

applicableLtv.description: The LTV that applies for the entered number of existing housing loans, as a decimal (0.75 = 75%).

applicableMinCashPercent.description: Mandatory cash downpayment for the applicable LTV tier, as a decimal (0.05 = 5%): 5% at the full tier, 10% at the reduced tier, 25% with an outstanding housing loan.

benchmarkRate.description: The benchmark stress rate applied, as a percentage.

bindingConstraint.description: Which rule produces the lower maximum loan.

incomeBreakdown.description: The monthly components of qualifyingIncome (basic + variable + rental + funds), each rounded to the cent.

basic.description: Monthly basic income, recognised at 100%, in SGD.

funds.description: Recognised monthly income from pledged/show funds (amortised over 48 months), in SGD.

rental.description: Monthly rental income recognised at 70%, in SGD.

variable.description: Monthly variable income (NOA/variable) recognised at 70%, then /12, in SGD.

qualifyingIncome.description: Qualifying monthly income after MAS haircuts, in SGD.

recognisedAssetIncome.description: Recognised monthly income from assets and rental (rental + amortised pledged/unpledged), in SGD.

totalLiabilities.description: Total monthly liabilities for this borrower, in SGD.

fundsToQualify.description: When the loan does not qualify, the extra eligible funds that would make it qualify.

combination.description: A mix of pledged and show funds that closes the gap, split by combinationSplit.

pledgedFundsRequired.description: Pledged funds for the pledged portion of the gap, in SGD.

showFundsRequired.description: Show (unpledged) funds for the remaining portion of the gap, in SGD.

splitPledgedPercent.description: Fraction of the income gap covered by pledged funds (0–100).

incomeGap.description: Additional monthly qualifying income needed to qualify, in SGD (0 if it does).

pledgedFundsRequired.description: Additional pledged eligible funds needed to close the gap, in SGD.

qualifies.description: True if the proposed loan already passes for the selected property type.

unpledgedFundsRequired.description: Additional unpledged eligible funds ("show funds") needed to close the gap, in SGD.

iwaa.description: Income-Weighted Average Age (years); 0 when income is zero.

qualifyingIncome.description: Total household qualifying monthly income, in SGD.

totalLiabilities.description: Total household monthly liabilities, in SGD.

insufficientIncome.description: True if total household income is zero, so ratios cannot be assessed.

ltv.description: Lower-LTV-tier flags, informational only; LTV is out of scope for this checker.

lowerTier.description: True if the loan falls into the reduced-LTV tier. LTV itself is not computed here.

reasons.description: Which trigger(s) put the loan into the lower LTV tier (tenure or age 65).

maxLoanHdbEc.description: Maximum loan under HDB/EC rules: the lower of the MSR and TDSR caps, in SGD.

maxLoanPrivate.description: Maximum loan under private property rules (TDSR-bound), in SGD.

maxPrice.description: Max property price at the applicable LTV for the entered housing-loan count, using the max loan for the property type (MSR-bound for HDB/EC), in SGD.

monthlyInstalment.description: Monthly instalment on the proposed loan at the benchmark stress rate, in SGD.

cap.description: Regulatory cap as a decimal fraction (0.30 = 30%).

pass.description: True if the ratio is at or below the cap.

ratio.description: Computed ratio as a decimal fraction (0.182 = 18.20%).

priceIf.description: Max purchase price by number of existing housing loans; the LTV tier (full / reduced / none) follows whether the loan extends past age 65 / 75.

loans.description: Number of housing loans the borrower would hold (1, 2 or 3+).

ltv.description: Applicable LTV for that loan count, as a decimal (0.75 = 75%).

maxPrice.description: Max property price at the max loan for the property type (MSR-bound for HDB/EC) and this LTV tier, in SGD.

propertyType.description: Property type the tenure and LTV-tier rules were applied for.

proposedLoanAmount.description: The proposed loan amount that was tested, in SGD.

qualifiesHdbEc.description: True if the proposed loan passes both MSR and TDSR (HDB/EC).

qualifiesPrivate.description: True if the proposed loan passes TDSR (private property).

tdsr.description: Total Debt Servicing Ratio (all property), capped at 55%.

cap.description: Regulatory cap as a decimal fraction (0.30 = 30%).

pass.description: True if the ratio is at or below the cap.

ratio.description: Computed ratio as a decimal fraction (0.182 = 18.20%).

effectiveYears.description: Tenure the result is actually calculated at: the requested tenure, lowered to maxYears when it exceeds it, in years.

limitedBy.description: Why effectiveYears is below the requested tenure: "age" when the loan must be repaid by 75, "cap" when the property type's regulatory maximum binds. Null when the requested tenure is used as is.

maxLoanTenorYears.description: Tenor the maximum loan is sized at: min(regulatory cap, 75 - IWAA), in whole years. Beyond age 75 the LTV is 0 so the loan is not financeable.

maxLtvYears.description: Longest loan tenure that still qualifies for the top LTV tier: min(LTV tenure cap of 30y private and EC / 25y HDB, 65 - IWAA), in whole years.

maxYears.description: Maximum loan tenure for these borrowers: the regulatory cap (35y private and EC, 30y HDB) limited so the loan is repaid by age 75, i.e. min(cap, 75 - IWAA), in years. Equal to maxLoanTenorYears.

requestedYears.description: Proposed tenure entered by the user, in years.

withinCap.description: True if the requested tenure is within the maximum loan tenure.

additionalLoan.description: Loan above the borrower’s current maximum that must be bridged, in SGD (0 if already reachable).

combination.description: A pledge/show mix that reaches the target, split by combinationSplit.

pledgedFundsRequired.description: Pledged funds for the pledged portion, in SGD.

showFundsRequired.description: Show funds for the remaining portion, in SGD.

splitPledgedPercent.description: Fraction of the gap covered by pledged funds (0–100).

incomeGap.description: Extra monthly qualifying income needed to service the additional loan, in SGD.

loanCappedByLtv.description: True when the supplied targetLoanAmount exceeds price × applicable LTV, so loanRequired was lowered to that cap.

loanRequired.description: Loan needed for the target at the first-loan LTV (price × LTV), in SGD.

pledgedFundsRequired.description: Pledged eligible funds to reach the target on their own, in SGD.

priceDerived.description: True when no price was supplied and targetPurchasePrice was derived as targetLoanAmount / applicable LTV.

targetPurchasePrice.description: The target purchase price, in SGD: as supplied, or derived from the target loan.

unpledgedFundsRequired.description: Show (unpledged) funds to reach the target on their own, in SGD.

toReachTarget.description: Present only when targetPurchasePrice is supplied: the funds needed to reach that price.

warnings.description: Warning messages (insufficient income, tenure over the maximum).

title: Eligibility checker (TDSR / MSR)
